title: Egyptian Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with lentils, perfect for a chilly evening. This recipe is inspired by traditional Egyptian cuisine.
instructions: Heat some oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, carrot, and tomato to the pot. Cook for another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the lentil, cumin, coriander, and paprika to the pot. Stir well to combine.
Add enough water to the pot to cover the lentil mixture. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
